title: Lashay Uthanay Walay ka Laasha
body:
Laashe Uthane Wale Ka Laasha Na Uth Saka
Aise Gira Zameen Pe Pyaasa Na Uth Saka
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa Rokti Hi Reh Gai Khanjar Ruka Nahi
Sar Kaat Kay Hussain (as) Ka Jab Le Gaya Laeen
Gardan Se Maa Ne Hath Uthaya Na Uth Saka
<<DIVIDER>>
Beti Ghareeb Baap Ke Laashe Se Jab Milli
Shaana Hilla Hilla Ke Utha Ti Hi Reh Gayi
Haye Magar Sakina (sa) Se Baba Na Uth Saka
<<DIVIDER>>
Bete Ko Maa Ki Gowd Mei Aisa Sukoon Milla
Usko Khabar Hi Na Huwi Khanjar Kab Chala
Thak Kar Hussain (as) Ghum Se Jo Soya Na Uth Sakka
<<DIVIDER>>
Tooti Sinna Jawaan Ke Sinne Se Khench Kar
Bete Ki Laash Baap Se Uth Tho Gayi Magar
Ulja Huwa Sinna Mei Kaleja Na Uth Saka
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar (as) Ko Jab Lehad Mei Utaara Hussain Ne
Phir Se Galle Lagana Jo Chaaha Hussain (as) Ne
Che Maa Ka Hussain (as) Se Bacha Na Uth Saka
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas (as) Aur Hussain (as) Ki Ghurbat Ka Woh Safar
Bhai Tarapta Reh Gaya Bhai Ki Laash Par
Tooti Huwi Kamar Thi Janaza Na Uth Saka
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindaan e Shaam Touq Wo Zanjeer Beriyan
Mushkil Mei Saath Dene Challi Aayi Bibiya
Abid (as) Se Jab Sakina (sa) Ka Laasha Na Uth sakka
<<DIVIDER>>
Zeeshan O Fatemah Wo Chali Jab Suey Watan
Khoon e Hussain (as) Dekh Kay Roti Rahi Behan
Zainab (sa) Se Apne Bhai Ka Kurta Na Uth Saka
